title: Reporting Bargaining Shifts in Mediation Minutes
goal: Report prior bargaining positions and conditional warnings in mediation minutes with «sostener», «advertir», «aclarar» and «anunciar».

items: I can report prior bargaining positions and conditional warnings in mediation minutes with «sostener», «advertir», «aclarar» and «anunciar».
I can distinguish backshifted past commitments (imperfect, pluperfect, conditional) from offers that remain active at the time of reporting.
I can use deadlock and breakthrough vocabulary («el punto muerto», «estancarse», «estancado», «desbloquear», «el desacuerdo», «la moratoria», «el ultimátum», «renegociar»).
